description: This PHP class defines the WorkScheduleService for the OrangeHRM system, handling retrieval and instantiation of employee work schedule objects based on configuration, with dependency injection, class existence validation, and caching.

classes.name: WorkScheduleService
classes.description: Service class responsible for providing employee work schedule instances, with configuration and caching logic.

methods.name: getWorkSchedule
methods.description: Returns a work schedule object for a given employee number, instantiating and caching it if necessary, or throwing exceptions if configuration is invalid.
